Toronto, Canada169 contributions

Delicious food, excellent service, great spot for lunch nearby the Ho Chi Minh Museum
Jun 2025 • Couples
We came here as a couple for lunch in June 2025. We were warmly greeted by staff who spoke good English. He enthusiastically explained to us the popular items on the menu. Their famous egg noodles are made in house. We ordered the Crab Meat mala sauce with egg noodle, Red Chamber Chicken with egg noodle, a side of Taiwanese popcorn chicken, and mulberry juice. The food was very delicious and light. The restaurant takes both cash and credit card payment (with fee), and is clean and comfortably cool. The restaurant is also very close (about a 10 minute walk) to the Ho Chi Minh Museum and Presidential Palace. I highly recommend this restaurant if you are looking for a place for a nice lunch either before or after your visit to the Ho Chi Minh Museum.

A Delightful Meal Worth Savoring
Feb 2025 • Solo
I had the pleasure of trying Red Chamber Chicken Rice, and it was nothing short of exceptional. The dish was beautifully presented, with tender, succulent chicken slices arranged neatly beside fragrant, perfectly cooked rice. The subtle aroma of pandan leaves and the light seasoning made each bite incredibly satisfying.

The accompanying dipping sauce added a wonderful depth of flavor, balancing savory and slightly sweet notes with a hint of spice. The pickled vegetables and fresh lettuce on the side provided a refreshing contrast, making the meal feel well-rounded.

To top it off, a glass of iced tea complemented the dish perfectly, cleansing the palate after each bite. I enjoyed it so much that I left my plate spotless—a true testament to how delicious it was.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a comforting yet flavorful meal!
